d.ko: A single-player xianxia sandbox game. The world evolves on its own: some cultivate, some gather and trade goods, some take masters and start families, some feud over a chance. Seclude yourself for years and years pass. When you die, a child or disciple carries on: the same world, the same karma.

d.zh: 《归墟行：人界篇》是一款单机修仙沙盒游戏。这个世界动态演进：有人苦修，有人采集供货，有人拜师成家，也有人为机缘结仇。你闭关几年，世上便过去几年。你寿尽之后，子女或徒弟会传承下去，还是这个世界，还是那些因果。
